current_default: The experimental focal CUDA provider selects native spin-blocked UCCSD-F12b for eligible UHF requests. Conventional triples remain the default. Explicit Köhn (T)-F12 is an opt-in RHF singlet energy.
generated_capability: DF sources use generated integral evaluation and compensated MO transformations. Restricted explicit (T)-F12 reuses the generated conventional triples panel, moment and energy routines.
missing_capability: Spin-blocked residuals, Lambda pullbacks, unrestricted triples and fixed-cusp terms still have manually maintained CUDA equations. Explicit (T)-F12 has no UHF or analytic molecular-force endpoint.
retirement_condition: Migrate each manual equation when a compiler-owned implementation passes independent energy or gradient and full-endpoint capacity gates for the same spin, precision and basis domains.
